description: A lightweight Flutter BitTorrent plugin powered by libtorrent, C++ and Dart FFI for magnet links, torrent status, file selection, local HTTP streaming and controlled prefetching.
rules: Use the public Dart API in lib/intorrent.dart for application code.
Do not use internal FFI bindings directly unless working on InTorrent itself.
InTorrent currently implements the Flutter plugin on Android.
The native build pins libtorrent to v2.1.1.
Do not assume planned iOS, Windows, macOS or Linux support is implemented.
Wait for torrent metadata before calling listFiles or streamUrl.
Use the documented InTorrent API and examples instead of inventing unsupported methods.
